## 🛠️ Technical Skills

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-align: center
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

categories = ['Programming', 'Data Tools', 'Visualization', 'Soft Skills']
skills_data = {
    'Programming': ['Python', 'R', 'SQL'],
    'Data Tools': ['Excel', 'Power BI', 'Pandas'],
    'Visualization': ['Matplotlib', 'Seaborn', 'Power BI'],
    'Soft Skills': ['Leadership', 'Communication', 'Problem Solving']
}

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

colors = ['#3498db', '#2ecc71', '#e74c3c', '#f39c12']
x = np.arange(len(categories))
width = 0.6

bars = ax.bar(x, [3, 3, 3, 3], width, color=colors, edgecolor='white', linewidth=2)

ax.set_ylabel('Number of Skills', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_title('Skills by Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(categories, fontsize=11)
ax.set_ylim(0, 4)

# Add skill names on bars
for i, (cat, skills) in enumerate(skills_data.items()):
    skill_text = '\n'.join(skills)
    ax.text(i, 1.5, skill_text, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='white')

ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
